security_controls.https: Enforced (ingress: allowInsecure=false, transport=Auto, TLS termination at Azure Container Apps)
security_controls.authentication: HMAC-SHA256 signature + timestamp freshness (±5min) + nonce replay prevention

security_controls.logging_auditability: SHA-256 audit trail. DecisionSession, ConsentEvent, AuditEvent entities. All external action attempts logged.
security_controls.health_checks: GET /api/health endpoint (status, version, signing, dependencies). Azure Container Apps liveness/readiness probes.
security_controls.rollback: Azure Container Apps revision-based rollback. Previous revisions preserved: 0000036 (v1.0.1), 0000035 (v1.0), etc.
security_controls.data_privacy: User-scoped data isolation. Memory requires consent. No raw payloads in audit logs (SHA-256 hashes only). Consent-scoped RAG. Right-to-forget endpoint.
